evidence.quote: White Labeler takes any proven page and mirrors it for your brand. All right. Um, and there's a four-step process. First, we mirror a page, which is basically create a template of the page that is already existing. Then, we rebrand it, right? We change the colors. We change the branding. We change everything about the page so that it more so reflects our style. Then we're going to upgrade the page. This is a new feature that we've added where it'll go through identify all the weaknesses of the page and it will build sections that are missing. You're going to want to watch this fully and then we launch on Shopify.
